tools.title: Farmer tools
tools.water: How many liters each bed needs today, from the weather forecast.
tools.health: Disease and pest risk from your own sensors.
tools.book: Harvests, sales and costs, and a listing to send to buyers.

farm.locationHelp: Needed for the weather forecast. It stays on this phone.
farm.gpsFailed: Could not get the location. Type the coordinates instead.
farm.badCoords: Check the coordinates, for example 36.75 and 3.06.

water.title: Water plan
water.timing: Water before 9:00 or after 18:00: less water is lost to the sun and wind.
water.hotDay: Hot day, up to {{temp}} °C. Water at dawn and shade young plants.
water.rainDay: {{mm}} mm of rain expected, already counted in.
water.forecastError: Could not load the weather forecast.
water.cached: No connection: showing the forecast saved on {{when}}.
water.method: Crop water use = evapotranspiration (FAO-56, Open-Meteo) × crop factor {{kc}}, minus 80 % of the rain, plus 10 % drip losses.
water.flowHelp: Drip flow = number of drippers × liters per hour each (often 2 L/h).

health.title: Plant health
health.disclaimer: Risk from the weather on your farm, not a diagnosis. Check the plants before you treat.
health.noSensor: Not enough temperature and humidity readings from the bed sensor in the last 3 days.
health.fungalWhy_one: Worst day of the last 3: {{count}} very humid hour (90 %+, 10–25 °C).
health.fungalWhy_other: Worst day of the last 3: {{count}} very humid hours (90 %+, 10–25 °C).

fungalAdvice.low: Nothing to do. Keep watering at the roots, not on the leaves.
fungalAdvice.medium: Open the greenhouse in the morning, water the soil, not the leaves, and check the lower leaves for spots.
fungalAdvice.high: Blight weather. Check tomato and potato leaves today for brown spots with a pale edge. Remove sick leaves and ventilate. If you spray, do it before rain, not after.

health.mildewWhy_one: {{count}} warm, half-humid hour in the last 3 days.
health.mildewWhy_other: {{count}} warm, half-humid hours in the last 3 days.

mildewAdvice.medium: Look under the leaves of cucumber, zucchini and melon for white powder.
mildewAdvice.high: Mildew weather. Check cucurbits and peppers, remove white-powdered leaves, and keep plants spaced for air.

health.tutaSince: Counting since (planting or last trap check)
health.tutaDD: {{dd}} degree-days so far. One moth generation needs about 460.
health.tutaCheck: A new generation of moths is about to fly. Check the pheromone traps and look for mines in the leaves this week.
health.tutaWait: Keep the traps up and check them weekly.

book.title: Farm book
book.incomplete: Fill in the crop and a quantity or amount.
book.empty: Nothing yet. Add your first harvest, sale or cost.
book.notSaved: This browser blocks storage: entries will be lost when the app closes. Export them.

listing.headline: 🌱 Fresh {{crop}} straight from the farm
listing.footer: Grown with drip irrigation, picked to order.
